description: This file defines an immutable class 'ImmutableAcknowledgement' implementing the 'Acknowledgement' interface, representing acknowledgments within a signaling system, including serialization to JSON and handling of headers and status codes.

classes.name: ImmutableAcknowledgement
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the Acknowledgement interface, encapsulating label, entity ID, status code, headers, and optional payload, with methods for JSON serialization and header/status management.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new ImmutableAcknowledgement instance with specified label, entity ID, status code, headers, and payload.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the acknowledgment.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID associated with the acknowledgment.

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.description: Determines if the acknowledgment indicates a successful response based on the label and status code.

methods.name: isTimeout
methods.description: Checks if the acknowledgment status code indicates a timeout.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code associated with the acknowledgment.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the payload entity as an optional JsonValue, based on a specified schema version.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Returns a new acknowledgment instance with an updated payload.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the headers associated with this acknowledgment.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new acknowledgment instance with updated headers.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type of the associated entity ID.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the string type corresponding to the entity type.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the acknowledgment to a JSON object according to the specified schema version and predicate.
